runs.intent: Add idempotent payment-attempt tracking without changing capture semantics.
acceptance: A repeated attempt id is rejected without mutating prior payment state.
Attempt outcome is one of approved, declined, or error.
Add behavioral tests in test/payment-attempts.test.js; new and unchanged baseline tests pass with npm test.

runs.intent: Add bounded refunds for captured payments without changing authorization semantics.
acceptance: Refunds are allowed only after capture and cannot exceed capturedMinor.
The aggregate records refundedMinor and moves to partially_refunded or refunded.
The original proposal names migrations/002_refunds.sql; if PAY-201 has landed, the human must require a rebase and migrations/003_refunds.sql before the file is created.
Add behavioral tests in test/refunds.test.js; new tests and unchanged baseline/PAY-201 tests pass with npm test.
